description: Biz, 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge Ankara Yerel Etkinliği'ne katılan Yıldız Tozu takımıyız. Bu challenge kapsamında; bilimi ve eğlenceyi bir araya getirerek sürükleyici bir Uzay Görevi Tasarım Oyunu (Space Mission Design Game) geliştiriyoruz. Amacımız; karmaşık havacılık mühendisliğini, yörünge mekaniğini ve uzay keşfini interaktif bir oyun deneyimiyle herkes için erişilebilir ve eğlenceli kılmak!
summary: Hello, we are the Stardust team. We drew inspiration from our team's name while developing this project. The game features distinct tasks for each planet, which are carried out on their respective worlds; these tasks have been designed based on the specific characteristics of each planet. The primary objective of this project is to help users learn about space while ensuring they have an enjoyable gaming experience. We spent approximately 15 hours developing this game, making extensive use of NASA’s data—particularly when defining the tasks. In an era where humanity has become increasingly dependent on technology, this game serves as an accessible tool that leverages that very technology to facilitate learning.
details: This project enables humanity—now deeply integrated with technology and increasingly detached from astronomy and space—to easily reconnect with these fields, allowing individuals to learn about them in an engaging and enjoyable way. Our primary objective is to reignite people's interest in space and astronomy. In developing this project, we utilized the JavaScript programming language, alongside various resources such as computers, tablets, and a range of websites. The entire concept for the project was conceived by Elif Bilge Hızır and Ela Dalga Çelik, members of the "Yıldıztozt" team. Before development, we conducted research to ensure that no similar project already existed. Throughout the creation process, we focused on ensuring the project remained original, creative, compelling, and easily accessible.
